description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the Schedule to the Order establishing the University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka by the addition new item : "6 Department of Basic Sciences"
categorisation: This gazette content involves an amendment to a university's academic structure (adding a Department of Basic Sciences to the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences at the University of Peradeniya). While it references a Minister by name, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities. The content specifically deals with educational/academic matters under the Universities Act, which falls under the Miscellaneous category (Type 10) for educational matters and academic appointments.
